name: TCS
recent: TCS 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间出现多项人事变动，包括董事局成员、公司秘书及大股东 DATO' ONG KING SENG 的股权申报变动。公司随后于 11 月 25 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩。
notable: 董事局成员 MR WONG CHOO LEONG 出现变动。
公司秘书由 LEOW EE WEN 及 ANG WEE MIN 接任。
大股东 DATO' ONG KING SENG 于 10 月两度申报股权变动。
risks: 大股东 DATO' ONG KING SENG 在 10 月连续申报股权变动，具体增减方向未在标题中说明。

recent_en: TCS saw several personnel changes between October and November 2026, including boardroom changes, company secretary changes and shareholding interest filings by substantial shareholder DATO' ONG KING SENG. The company subsequently released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November.
notable_en: Boardroom change involving MR WONG CHOO LEONG.
Company secretary changes with LEOW EE WEN and ANG WEE MIN appointed.
Substantial shareholder DATO' ONG KING SENG filed shareholding interest changes twice in October.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder DATO' ONG KING SENG filed consecutive shareholding interest changes in October; the direction of the change is not stated in the titles.
